title: On congruence subgroups of $\SL_2(\Z[\frac{1}{p}])$ generated by two parabolic elements
annotation:
For $q = r/p$ with $p$ prime, conjectures that the group generated by $\mat1011$ and $\mat1q01$ is an explicit congruence subgroup of $\SL_2(\Z[1/p])$, and proves it when $r \le 4$ and in some cases with $r = 5$ (from the abstract). In those cases the group has finite index, so it is far from free.
